title: FBI Photo B24
doc_notes: This document is an FBI submission to AARO containing a single IR still image of a UAP, noting that the timestamp on the image itself is incorrect.

incidents.summary: A grainy monochrome IR image of a single dark, irregular-shaped object captured by a U.S. military system.
incidents.quote: A single dark, irregular-shaped object is visible just above the center of the reticle.
